CO-16.title: Claim/Service Lacks Information or Has Submission/Billing Error(s)
action_checklist: Verify patient subscriber ID, group number, and date of birth against eligibility portal.
Confirm referring/ordering provider NPI is populated in Box 17/17b.
Check if required modifier (e.g., -25, -59, -KX, -NU) was omitted.
CO-16.appeal_template:
Re: Corrected Claim / Missing Information Resubmission (CARC CO-16)

Please reprocess the attached claim for Date of Service {dos}. The omitted/corrected billing information ({missing_detail}) has been updated and verified against the patient's active policy. Kindly adjudicate per the contracted fee schedule.

CO-97.title: Benefit Included in Payment/Allowance for Another Service/Procedure
action_checklist: Review NCCI (National Correct Coding Initiative) bundling edits for the CPT/HCPCS pair.
Verify clinical documentation supports a distinct procedural service or separate evaluation.
Append appropriate modifier (-25 for distinct E/M, -59 or -XS/-XE for distinct procedure) if supported by chart notes.
CO-97.appeal_template:
Re: Formal Appeal for Unbundling / Distinct Service (CARC CO-97)

We respectfully request reconsideration of CPT {cpt} billed on {dos}. As documented in the enclosed clinical progress notes, this procedure/evaluation was distinct, separately identifiable, and medically necessary outside the global/bundled service. Modifier {modifier} applies. Please reprocess for separate reimbursement.

CO-197.title: Precertification/Authorization/Notification Absent
action_checklist: Locate valid prior authorization number and effective date range in EHR/portal.
If auth was obtained post-service or retro-auth applies, attach payer confirmation log.
Confirm rendering provider NPI and CPT/HCPCS code match the approved authorization.
CO-197.appeal_template:
Re: Prior Authorization Verification & Reconsideration (CARC CO-197)

Please reconsider the denial on {dos} for CPT/HCPCS {cpt}. Valid authorization #{auth_number} was secured for this service within the active coverage window (proof of authorization attached). Kindly overturn the CO-197 denial and process payment.

PR-1.title: Deductible Amount (Patient Responsibility)
action_checklist: Verify remaining annual deductible in payer portal to confirm accuracy.
Check if patient has active secondary coverage (e.g., Medicare Supplement / Medigap) for crossover.
Transfer balance to secondary payer or generate itemized patient statement.
PR-1.appeal_template:
Patient Statement / Secondary Crossover Notice (CARC PR-1)

Per the primary Explanation of Benefits (EOB) for {dos}, ${patient_resp} was applied toward the patient's annual deductible. Routing balance to secondary policy / patient statement queue.

CO-29.title: The Time Limit for Filing Has Expired
action_checklist: Pull original clearinghouse batch acceptance report (277CA) showing initial timely submission.
Verify if claim was originally sent to a prior/incorrect payer in good faith.
Submit timely filing appeal with clearinghouse timestamp proof within payer reconsideration window.
CO-29.appeal_template:
Re: Timely Filing Proof Appeal (CARC CO-29)

Enclosed is the clearinghouse electronic acceptance receipt confirming that Claim #{claim_id} for {dos} was originally transmitted and accepted within your contracted timely filing window. Please reopen and adjudicate this claim accordingly.
